audience: allied health and wellbeing practices that run their clinic in Halaxy and want help with scheduling and fees

useCases.title: Find open appointment times
useCases.text: The AI finds appointment times in a date range for a given duration, narrowed to a practitioner or clinic, and respects your online booking preferences.

useCases.title: Browse schedules and time slots
useCases.text: The AI lists the schedules of your practitioners and their time slots, so you can see which times are open or busy this week.

useCases.title: List your appointment types and fees
useCases.text: The AI lists the appointment types and the fees your practice charges for, so you can check the price list in one place.

useCases.title: See your practitioners and clinics
useCases.text: The AI lists the practitioners, their roles at each clinic location and the practice group, with the ids you need for other tools.
